latest.title: Halloween Interlopers
highlights: New robot: Nekton (EvoLife flying tripod, 1 Heavy + 3 Light, 320,000 durability, 55 km/h). Abyss: takes flight with an Absorber shield for 10 s; every 25,000 damage taken adds 1 s, up to 8 s extra.
New weapons: Mesmer L/M/H, 600 m energy beam that stacks BLAST; 1690 / 2535 / 3380 damage per particle at full charge.
New drone: Object. New mothership: Roswell (lifts your robot above the deployment point, adds damage, turns damage taken into DoT).
New ultimate editions: Ultimate Loki (3 Light, 280,000 durability, 60 km/h) and Ultimate Gust (3289 per particle, 6 particles, 500 m).
New pilots: The Martian (Nekton, Mesmer L/H), Orson Barret (Ultimate Rhino, Ultimate Toxin/Venom), Darian Grief (Ultimate Loki, Ultimate Gust).
Unstable Conduit module: +35% extra durability, +20% speed for 6 s. Tactical Shift: Ground Zero, the centre of the map grants Aegis, damage resistance or repair.
Event: Halloween Interlopers runs from 27 October with daily rewards in the Event Hub. Finish it for the title HALLOWEEN INTERLOPER.

cards.head: New pilot Andor Miharr buffs Shell
cards.body: Andor Miharr has two skills. A Bet on Life increases Shell's damage while the ability is active. Infinite Luck makes Glacier, Cryo and Rime deal more damage. The notes give no numbers for either skill.
cards.why: William owns Shell. The published A Bet on Life skill increases Shell damage while its ability is active.

cards.head: New pilot Donnie Woo
cards.body: Donnie Woo brings two skills. Donnie's Blindness makes gravity missiles deal additional damage and inflict Blind. Woo Hoo decreases the primary charge reload time of Iaraghi. The notes give no numbers for either skill.

cards.head: New robot Dedopali
cards.body: Dedopali arrives with 330,000 durability, 50 km/h movement speed and a loadout of 1 Heavy plus 2 Light slots. It carries Swarm, which deploys three autonomous pods, Invisibility lasting 7 seconds on a 15 second cooldown, and Gravity Lift lasting 7 seconds, with an 8 second ability cooldown. The MK2 bonus raises Gravity Lift duration from 5 to 7 seconds and the MK3 bonus raises Invisibility duration from 5 to 7 seconds.

cards.head: New weapons Iaraghi Light, Medium and Heavy
cards.body: Iaraghi is a charge up energy weapon with the Defense Breach effect and 600 m range. At full charge it deals 45,000 damage per particle in the Light version, 67,500 in the Medium version and 90,000 in the Heavy version, firing 6 particles per shot at a 1 second shot interval. Ammo is 6, reload interval is 5 seconds primary plus 5 seconds secondary, and reload amount is 1 primary plus 5 secondary. The notes state that the secondary charges ignore any Defense Mitigation, Reflector and Forcefield defence systems, and that when the weapon is fully charged its main charge gets the same effect.
cards.why: William owns Shell, Dux MK2 and Frozen Dagon MK2. The published Defense Breach effect means Iaraghi charges ignore Defense Mitigation, Reflector and Forcefield defence systems.

cards.head: Simulation Errors event
cards.body: The 12.4 event started on September 22, with daily rewards in the Event Hub and the News section. Its collectible reward is the title SIMULATION OPERATOR.

cards.head: Spare Parts replace upgrade timers
cards.body: The post says the feature is being tested throughout Update 12.4 and that the developers may scale it back or scrap it, so these figures are not final. Upgrade timers are replaced by a Spare Parts currency that the Workshop produces automatically at 1,500 Spare Parts per day, which the post describes as just a notch over one part per minute. Production pauses once the slot reaches 1,500 Spare Parts until the parts are collected. Upgrades become instant on activation and cost Silver plus Spare Parts, and Gold can buy Spare Parts directly.
cards.why: The published change replaces upgrade timers with Spare Parts for every robot and weapon in William's hangar.

cards.head: Technical fixes in 12.4
cards.body: The patch corrects the Durability Extender turret durability increase and resolves a Tensor and Raptor Gray damage reduction issue. It also fixes event display and access button problems and a black or gray screen bug in combat.

cards.head: Tier 4 robot upgrade cost in Spare Parts
cards.body: The post sets Tier 4 robot MK1 costs at 100, 300, 600, 900, 1,200, 1,500, 1,800, 2,100, 2,400, 2,700 and 3,000 Spare Parts for levels 1 through 11, then 3,000 Spare Parts for each MK2 level from 1 through 11. It states that what used to take 83,820 minutes now takes 49,600 Spare Parts, which take roughly 47,600 minutes to produce. The post says the feature is under test during 12.4, so these figures are not final.
cards.why: William's MK2 robots include Samjok MK2, ULTIMATE Spectre MK2, Dux MK2 and Frozen Dagon MK2. The post sets 3,000 Spare Parts per level for Tier 4 robot MK2 levels.

cards.head: Tier 4 weapon upgrade cost in Spare Parts
cards.body: The post sets Tier 4 weapon MK1 costs at 100, 200, 400, 600, 800, 1,000, 1,200, 1,400, 1,600, 1,800 and 2,000 Spare Parts for levels 1 through 11, then 2,000 Spare Parts for each MK2 level from 1 through 11. It states that 65,460 minutes of upgrade time are substituted with 33,100 Spare Parts. The post says the feature is under test during 12.4, so these figures are not final.
cards.why: William's MK2 weapons include Kirin MK2 and Discipline MK2. The post sets 2,000 Spare Parts per level for Tier 4 weapon MK2 levels.

cards.head: Ultimate Glacier released
cards.body: Ultimate Glacier has 350 m range, 4,032 damage per particle, 1 particle per shot, a 0.06 second shot interval, 35 ammo, a 0.3 second reload interval and a reload amount of 1.

cards.head: Ultimate Rime released
cards.body: Ultimate Rime has 350 m range, 2,205 damage per particle, 1 particle per shot, a 0.06 second shot interval, 35 ammo, a 0.3 second reload interval and a reload amount of 1.

cards.head: Ultimate Shell released
cards.body: Ultimate Shell has 601,000 durability, 43 km/h movement speed and 1 Heavy plus 2 Light slots. Its Ultimate Atom ability lasts 7 seconds on a 5 second cooldown and raises speed by 245 percent, with front shields of 305,550, side shields of 213,900 and rear shields of 168,000. The MK2 bonus adds 20 percent ability damage and the MK3 bonus adds 50 percent shield durability. The notes also say the blast radius is expanded and that the physical shields now fully regenerate with each ability activation, with no before and after figure given for the blast radius.
cards.why: William owns Shell. The published Ultimate version carries 601,000 durability, the Ultimate Atom ability and shields that fully regenerate on each activation.

cards.head: Ultimate cryogenic weapons buffed
cards.body: The notes say cryogenic weapons were buffed across the board with an increased fire rate, faster reload speed, higher damage and a larger area of effect radius. The post names Glacier, Cryo and Rime and gives no before and after numbers for the buff itself.

cards.head: Live Show 26 Martian Robotic Games and Gift Marathons
cards.body: The official Live Show hub publishes the Martian Robotic Games, a competition among five corporations across weekly disciplines, with dates given as April 14 to May 19. The page says the corporation that wins each week determines the following week's Gift Marathon, and that the MRG winner chooses the build given away in the 12.1 Gift Marathon. It also lists a Titan Tournament extra reward for weekly voting and a People's Choice poll where each vote counts as 5,000,000 Durability repaired for the chosen corporation. The page states no reward contents and no dates for the Gift Marathons themselves.
